ns2:section.sectionText: Classes meet on Fridays from 5:30pm to 9:30pm and on Saturdays from 8:00am to 4:00pm. Course meetings are September 6-7, October 4-5, November 1-2, and December 6-7. Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $582.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
